styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, blush cherry-pink #F7E4E4 panels for info and stage shots, deep rose #C96A70 for hero and closing statements
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm studio lighting, gentle gradients, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte blush podium and light beige stone vanity counter
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line floral bottle icons in the deep rose accent only
styleLock.presentationRules: round glass bottle always upright, stable scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent romantic rose perfume ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, blush cherry-pink #F7E4E4, deep rose accent #C96A70 and warm charcoal text #4A3F3C; soft warm studio lighting with gentle gradients, front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line floral icon style in the deep rose accent; clean premium beauty photography mixed with minimal infographic panels; stable product scale with the round glass bottle presented upright; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1为樱花粉幕布舞台主视觉，圆玻璃瓶金色方盖，配非洲菊与珍珠道具及「玫瑰轻奢淡香水」标题；屏2为模特情感文案屏（模特可辨识面容）并出现「720分钟」时长宣传；屏3为「留香12H」大数字屏与产品信息表（产品名称玫瑰轻奢淡香水、香水类型EDP、香调玫瑰轻奢、净含量50ML、适用成年女性、保质期3年）；屏4为香调结构屏（前中后调具体香材名）；屏5为铝制喷头与玻璃瓶身细节屏；屏6-7为产品实拍与喷雾法使用说明（含约10-20厘米喷距数值）及二维码与会员促销角标。品类判定依据：信息表明确品名「淡香水」、类型「香水EDP」、适用「成年女性」，属着彩/香氛类美妆商品而非洗护，故改判为美妆彩妆/香氛，leaf=玫瑰轻奢淡香水。已剥离内容：模特面容与人像（改为背影/腕部裁切）、品牌字与系列字样、留香12H/720分钟时长断言、50ML净含量与3年保质期等规格数值、前中后调具体香材名、喷距数值、二维码、会员与促销角标、原文案原句；EDP与「淡香水」的类型表述在源页并存且不一致，两种均未作为事实写入，香型结构一律以 {callout_n} 空白面板占位。
